            ONCOR AND LCRA TSC’S LIST OF INTERVENORS WHO DID NOT FILE
                     TESTIMONY OR A STATEMENT OF POSITION

          On March 26, 2026, Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC (“Oncor”) and LCRA

Transmission Services Corporation (“LCRA TSC,” and, together with Oncor, “Applicants”) filed

a joint application to amend their certificates of convenience and necessity for the Bell County

East Switch to Big Hill Substation 765 kilovolt (“kV”) transmission line project in Bell, Burnet,

Concho, Coryell, Lampasas, Llano, Mason, McCullough, Menard, Milam, Mills, San Saba,

Schleicher, Tom Green, and Williamson counties, Texas. On March 30, 2026, the Public Utility

Commission of Texas referred this docket to the State Office of Administrative Hearings

(“SOAH”). On March 31, 2026, the SOAH Administrative Law Judges (“ALJs”) issued SOAH

Order No. 1, which affirmed April 27, 2026 as the deadline to intervene. 1 On April 20, 2026, the

SOAH ALJs issued SOAH Order No. 6, which, among other things, (1) established May 13, 2026,

as the deadline for intervenors to file testimony or a statement of position; (2) ordered that, if an
